## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon is a lenient teacher who is entirely ineffective as an instructor. His approach to discipline is disgraceful and harsh, resorting to constantly striking while failing to maintain any actual order.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Mr. Pidgeon was a schoolmaster who constantly struck his students yet maintained no discipline whatsoever. During his tenure at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school, he punished [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for smashing her slate over Hugh Carrow's head by making her stand at the front of the classroom and subsequently sit beside Hugh. He later departed from his position at the school on its last day of term.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--pidgeon.md)

Mr. Pidgeon serves as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) Harcourt's school teacher at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school. Their classroom relationship turns contentious when Mr. Pidgeon punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for smashing her slate over Hugh Carrow's head by making her stand at the front of the room and sit beside Hugh, causing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to refuse to return to school. Despite this conflict, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later becomes emotional when Mr. Pidgeon leaves his position at the school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +6 more_

- Mentor of — school teacher and pupil  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

### [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/pidgeon--sukey-pullen.md)

Mr. Pidgeon is romantically involved with [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md). He courts her and spends time visiting her on an almost nightly basis.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)_
